items.zh_title: Meta AI助手Muse上线40天美国下载量破千万，仅11款应用曾达成该纪录
items.zh_oneliner: Muse 上线 40 天在美国下载量突破一千万，此前仅 11 款应用达成过这一纪录。
items.en_title: Muse Passes 10 Million US Downloads in 40 Days, a Feat Only 11 Apps Have Achieved
items.en_oneliner: Muse passed 10 million downloads in the US within 40 days of launch — a milestone only 11 apps have ever reached.
